title: samuel-park-kubecon-2026-vendor-expense-scratchpad
content:
Purpose: personal/admin scratchpad for KubeCon SF 2026 travel logistics, vendor contacts, and expense reminders. Working notes - messy.

Key dates:
- KubeCon SF: 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-18
- Booth build: 2026-03-14 (evening)
- Ship swag crate out by: 2026-03-10 (priority)

Attendees from Redwood (confirmed):
- Samuel Park (me) - lead on vendor coordination / on-site logistics
- Olivia Park - booth lead day 1 & 2
- Jordan Kim - session presenter (travel covered by Speaker stipend)
- Maya Singh - swag / giveaways manager
- (Pending) Derek Huang - backup technical contact

Vendor contacts (quick):
- SwagCo (deliver T-shirts + stickers)
  - Contact: Priya Patel, priya@swagco.com, +1-415-555-2103
  - PO/Invoice note: needs company tax ID on invoice; turnaround 5 business days for rush order (confirm by 2026-02-20)
  - Current status: sample approved, final sizes spreadsheet submitted 2026-02-12

- Booth Builder (modular panels + shipping)
  - Contact: Marco Ruiz, marco@buildbooths.io, +1-206-555-0144
  - Quote ref: BB-7832 (attached in Confluence)
  - Payment terms: 50% deposit, remainder on delivery. Get deposit approval from finance by 2026-02-16

- Catering / On-site snacks (small booth snacks)
  - Contact: BlueBox Catering (events@blueboxsf.com), +1-415-555-9987
  - Need final headcount for 3 days (estimate 6 people on staff + visitors). Confirm by 2026-03-01

Expense reminders / process (to myself):
- Capture receipts same day in Expensify (use tag: kubecon-2026)
- Travel booking: use corporate travel portal (Concur) and code EV-1423 for booking approvals
- Expense codes: 
  - Flight = TRVL-FLT
  - Hotel = TRVL-HTL
  - Meals = TRVL-MEAL
  - Booth/Swag = MKT-BOOTH
  - Shipping = OPS-SHIP
- Deadline to submit pre-approval for booth deposit: 2026-02-16 (submit PO to finance + Slack finance channel)
- Per-diem guidance: meals reimbursed up to $75/day (if over, add note and manager approval)

Estimated budget (rough):
- Flights (5 pax): ~$3,200 total
- Hotel (5 pax, 4 nights): ~$5,000 (conference rate)
- Swag: $4,500 (bulk tees + stickers + pins)
- Booth build + shipping: $12,000 (deposit $6,000)
- Misc (catering, local transit, adapters): $1,500
- Contingency: $2,000
- Total est: ~$28,200

Action items (short):
- [ ] Upload final swag sizes CSV to SwagCo (sam) - due 2026-02-12 (done)
- [ ] Request PO for booth builder deposit (sam -> finance) - target 2026-02-16
- [ ] Confirm hotel room block & request invoice to pay (olivia) - 2026-02-18
- [ ] Book flights for Jordan (speaker stipend separate) - jordan to confirm dates by 2026-02-14
- [ ] Share travel checklist with team + emergency contact list (sam) - 2026-02-20
- [ ] Arrange swag crate pickup from warehouse (maya) - schedule pickup 2026-03-11

Receipts / Upload checklist:
- All receipts scanned and uploaded to Expensify within 7 days
- For card charges: add merchant note + color photo of receipt if printed
- Shipping docs: keep tracking number + bill of lading in Confluence page (KUBE-BOOTH-2026)

On-site logistics notes:
- Booth location: Hall B, inline 12 (map link in Confluence)
- Carpet color: dark gray - consider white table runner for contrast
- Power: 1 x 20A circuit reserved (confirm with Marco)
- Wifi: conference-provided; get 802.1x creds from events team day-of
- Tool kit: gaffer tape, velcro, scissors, multi-tool, extension cord, surge protector
- Arrival window for build crew: 08:00-12:00 2026-03-14 (need onsite contact number)

Questions to resolve (follow-ups):
- Do we need signed MSA with SwagCo for >$5k orders? Olivia to check legal 2026-02-13
- Can finance pre-approve deposit without tax ID on invoice? If not, push timeline
- Confirm whether speaker travel gets reimbursed via speaker program (Jordan) or via expense claim

Notes to self (random):
- Might be cheaper to ship swag via consolidated freight vs booth builder's recommended carrier - get 2 more quotes
- Check Redwood procurement preferred vendor list (Confluence) for any negotiated discounts
- Remind team to claim taxi/ride receipts separately - use "local-transit" tag

Quick links (save):
- Confluence booth page: (KUBE-BOOTH-2026)
- PO template: /finance/po-template (Confluence)
- Slack channel: #events-kubecon-2026
- Expense policy: /policies/expenses-2025 (Confluence)

End of scratchpad - will clean up into formal checklist once deposits confirmed.

Notes history: 2026-02-10 initial draft; 2026-02-12 added swag contact and sizes; 2026-02-14 updated budget estimates; 2026-02-18 added catering contact and action items.
